Luke was awesome! I brought my brand new shelter pup to this location on the way home, to see what sorts of toys/treats he might like.

Luke was so friendly and helpful, and obviously a big animal lover - which is exactly what you want from someone working at your local pet store 🐕

Thanks again for making my new buddy feel so comfortable and welcome! (Pic of the aftermath later that night after a big day, and enjoying his new Kong for awhile lol)

Knowledgeable, kind, caring people! Ever person I have encountered has been so helpful and, most importantly, kind to my dog. I feel like the staff at the store played a real part in helping me socialize my girl!

I went into the Petco on NW Hwy in Dallas, Tx. The person that I met coming in the door offered to help me locate what I was in for. She was very professional while being extremely personable. I went in there in hurry and an emergency situation after an afternoon at nearby, White rock Lake, my dog decided to roll around on the grass and picked up an awful smell of ungodly proportions, we could not stand the stench inside the vehicle. I went to the nearest Petco and despite being late in the day and the dog wash bay area being closed, I explained to the manager, how urgent of a matter this was due to the awful stench. Despite all this, the manager allowed me to take my dog into the *Now closed wash area, and I was able to wash my dog and get the awful stench off, the staff was very understanding and welcoming, and the did allow me to proceed despite being close to closing time. They truly saved the day and I was able to take my dog home without the awful smell. Thank you to the staff that helped that day!

Horrible! A grooming appointment scheduled.

1. Don’t show up 5 minutes early. You have a “STYLIST” that will speak with you at scheduled time.

2. My “STYLIST” freaked when I informed gave me dog Benadryl. Literally grabbing her chest like a stroke. Other stylist overheard and said,  It’s okay. Ridiculous.

3. Ask me to leave area, walk store so she could see how dog acted. Go back. She informed.. MAYBE this or that, unsure.

4….. No thank you! If a “STYLIST” is UNSURE that’s a SURE for me to leave with my pet. I understand my dogs anxiety with this girl. She holds your pet like they have parasites or fleas. We left and went directly to another spa my dog gets her nails trimmed & Perfection!

Will NEVER RETURN.
